answer: Each agent identity requires a TPM/SGX enclave to produce a zero-knowledge attestation of code, hardware key, and a VDF-bound nonce; the nectar state tree commits identities, fable is the consensus contract, and delta is the revocation hash anchor. Forging requires compromising distinct certified silicon or breaking enclave soundness and recomputing sequential VDFs; admission bonds follow an O(N^2) curve, with failed proofs irreversibly slashed.
